decision_summary: Decide: whether the new event needs a public deprecation plan. AR-1 found no conflict with accepted ADRs.

findings.text: Version 2.0.0 removes the field total_net, which is breaking, but 1.4.0 is not marked deprecated and has no sunset.
findings.rewording: Mark IF-003@1.4.0 deprecated with a sunset at least 90 days after deprecation.

findings.text: Option b relies on a shared store that ADR-002/C-1 allows only for read models; the option does not say which it is.
findings.rewording: State in option b that the shared store is a read model, as ADR-002/C-1 allows.

questions.text: Is IF-003 used by external consumers, so the 90-day sunset applies?

options.text: Option A: keep the current wording.
Option B: narrow it as the finding suggests.
